why: Forwarder gave up 2 of 4 pieces, about 1,200 kg, in writing; release exactly that, and volume in proportion to pieces (2/4 of 14.4 m3 = 7.2 m3), leaving 1,200 kg and 7.2 m3 booked (Space 3.1, 3.3, 5.1). Sources: booking B-02, forwarder F-02, message M-02, Space 3.1, Space 3.3, Space 5.1.
